subject.title: fix: prevent session exports from writing outside workspace

question: Should complete session exports be restricted to configured command owners, removing access from authorized non-owner senders?
rationale: The patch fixes a real vulnerability but intentionally changes a shipped authorization contract, so code correctness alone cannot choose the permanent policy.

options.title: Require command ownership
options.body: Approve owner-only session exports and land after exact-head packaged proof covers rejected and supported paths.

options.title: Separate delegated permission
options.body: Preserve helper export access only through a newly designed least-privilege permission while retaining workspace confinement.

recommendation.title: Require command ownership
recommendation.body: Approve owner-only session exports and land after exact-head packaged proof covers rejected and supported paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently shaped the current exporter implementation and direct-write path on main.
